user.description: Select the Nuki Opener to set up.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description:
Put the Opener into pairing mode: hold its button for 5 seconds until the LED ring lights up, then press Submit within 30 seconds.

Pairing as a bridge uses the Opener's single bridge slot; pairing as an app uses one of the app slots.

data.client_name: Name shown in the Nuki app

error.not_pairing_mode: The Opener is not in pairing mode. Hold its button for 5 seconds and try again.
error.pairing_failed: The Opener rejected the pairing. Check the log for details.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Opener over Bluetooth.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a Nuki Opener.
